meta.title: The Shevin Travels
rules: Florida intrastate trips are not counted.
States only driven through do not count.

Recurring places (Denver, Keystone, New York, Chicago, Boston, Las Vegas, New Orleans, Maine, Asheville) are listed once. Repeat visits there are not logged as trips unless they were a special occasion. Trips to anywhere else are logged every time.
US territories (Puerto Rico) and non-UN places (Cayman Islands) are not counted as countries.
Countries are out of 195: 193 UN members plus Vatican City and Palestine.
Full tracking starts in 2003, when Daryl and Ivory met. Earlier years include only select trips, mostly international.
